blocks.tamil_translation: when a man begins to obey his wife and disobey his mother; when he regards his friend as close and his father as distant from himself; when shouting is done openly in the masajid; when a major sinner is made leader of a community; when the administration of a group is entrusted to the most despicable of them; when a man is honoured in order to escape his evil; when female singers and musical instruments are played as a custom; when drinking alcohol becomes utterly commonplace; when the later ones of the Ummah curse the earlier ones — then await the punishments of a red wind, earthquakes, sinking into the earth, the transformation of people's faces, and a rain of stones from the sky'. Likewise, await also punishments coming in succession, just as when a necklace of beads strung on a thread snaps, the beads fall rapidly one after another." Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ مَثَلَ الَّذِي يَعْمَلُ السَّيِّئَاتِ ثُمَّ يَعْمَلُ الْحَسَنَاتِ، كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ دِرْعٌ ضَيِّقَةٌ قَدْ خَنَقَتْهُ، ثُمَّ عَمِلَ حَسَنَةً فَانْفَكَّتْ حَلَقَةٌٌ، ثُمَّ عَمِلَ حَسَنَةً أُخْرَي فَانْفَكَّتْ حَلَقَةٌ أُخْرَي، حَتَّي يَخْرُجَ إِلَي اْلاَرْضِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: "The example of a person who, after committing sins, then keeps doing good deeds is like one wearing a tight coat of iron armour! That armour is squeezing his neck. He does one good deed and one ring of the armour comes loose. Another good deed
